1.why: ChowPhaserFB.cpp divides this jack by 5 and LDR::getLDRResistance clamps the result to -1 and 1

0.why: setVoltage(std::tanh(y / 5.0f) * 5.0f) in ChowPhaserFB.cpp bounds the output to five volts either way

comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab, the commit that set the installed version 2.0.1, and doc/manual.md in the same tree. The skew knob runs -1 to 1 and is used as two raised to that power, the exponent applied to the control voltage mapped into 0 to 1 by LDR::lightShape. The feedback knob runs 0 to 0.95 and is negated where it is used. Neither knob was given a parameter name by the maker, so the panel is the only source for what they are called. A 15 nanofarad capacitor value sets the allpass corner alongside the modelled resistance.
